title: PoRace
tagline: A watch-only racing simulation: every racer is a physically simulated body moved by a learned brain.
intro: PoRace races very different creatures against each other on the same track under the same physics: a Unitree Go2 robot dog, a tall man (Matt), a small older woman (Grandma) and a jogging stroller.

Nobody steers and nothing is animated. MuJoCo simulates every body; each racer's brain learned to walk, run, recover and get up through reinforcement learning, and Unreal Engine 5 presents the race like a sports broadcast.
facts: MuJoCo 4.0.0 inside Unreal (URLab plugin); Chaos is off
PPO (Brax / mujoco_playground) exported to ONNX, run with Unreal NNE
A Python reference race on CPU MuJoCo matches the Unreal race seed for seed
